description: Single source of truth for CLI-carried tools, JS packages, native libraries, and source-triggered build features.

typescript.note: Vendored for tsconfig template emission by scripts/init.js. Typecheck (tsc invocation) is not wired.

v8.note: JS engine. libc_v8.a (~116 MB) is statically linked into every V8-backed cart and into tools/v8cli. The SDK ships the .a so the dispatcher's zig-build invocations can find it.

sdl3.note: Window/input. Every cart binary opens a window. We pin our own version, so SDL3.so ships in the SDK payload.

wgpu-native.note: Render backbone for every primitive. 241MB static archive linked into every cart. tools/v8cli and the rjit dispatcher don't carry it.

stb-image.note: Powers <Image>. Compiled into every cart from vendored C source — no .so to ship.

stb-image-write.note: Capture / witness screenshotting. Vendored C source.

luajit.note: framework/process/luajit_worker.zig dlopens libluajit-5.1 at runtime — no link-time dependency. framework/audio.zig still uses the zluajit module (Zig wrapper) which is gated by -Dhas-audio. Bundle libluajit-5.1.so alongside the cart when the lua-worker or audio feature triggers.

x11.note: Display server protocol. Linked at build time (windows.zig sets _NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE atoms via 2 extern Xlib calls), but every Linux desktop ships libX11. Don't bundle. Wayland-only systems ship Xwayland which provides libX11 too.

posix-threading.note: libc, libm, libpthread, libdl — present on every Linux host.

libmpv.note: Runtime dlopen — no link-time cost. Pack libmpv.so.2 into the SDK payload when has-video so carts can dlopen our pinned version instead of relying on the host.

libwebp.note: dlopen'd at runtime by framework/image/codec.zig (WebPEncodeRGBA / WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA / WebPDecodeRGBA / WebPGetInfo / WebPFree) when a cart encodes/decodes WebP via @reactjit/image — no link-time dependency, so PNG/JPEG-only carts never load it. Present on most Linux desktops (libwebp.so.7); pack-sdk stages it alongside the cart when the imageops feature triggers so WebP works on hosts that lack it.

sqlite3.note: dlopen'd at runtime by framework/storage/sqlite.zig — no link-time dependency. Registry entry exists so pack-sdk stages libsqlite3.so alongside the cart when the sqlite feature triggers.

curl.note: REMOVED. The networking stack now uses std.http.Client + tls.zig (framework/net/http.zig). libcurl and its entire transitive auth/TLS chain (~30MB) have been dropped from cart bundles. Do not add new code that links libcurl.

onnx-runtime.note: Microsoft ONNX Runtime CPU-only Linux x64 build (~22MB libonnxruntime.so + symlinks). Used by framework/ml/ for inference (currently MobileSAM for image segmentation in cart/cutout). See deps/onnxruntime/README.md for version + upgrade notes.

alsa.note: ALSA sequencer (libasound) for MIDI input on Linux. Linked only when -Dhas-midi=true; never bundled — every Linux desktop has libasound.so.2 in its base install.

tls.zig.note: Pulled in by http-client and sdk features.

macos-ui-frameworks.note: Every macOS host has Foundation/QuartzCore/Metal/Cocoa/IOKit/CoreVideo. Linked, not bundled.

window-runtime.note: Native libs (sdl3, wgpu-native, freetype, stb-image*, x11, posix-threading, macos-ui-frameworks) are foundational — always linked. The build option only signals intent; nothing extra is link-gated by it. No auto-trigger — pass -Dhas-window-runtime manually if a future site needs it.

window.note: Auto-fires when a cart imports <Window> (or <Notification>) from @reactjit/primitives. For ship-tui, this is the trigger that links SDL3 + the window-rendering engine subset into an otherwise-ANSI-only TUI binary so a <Window> subtree can paint as a real GPU window from inside the same React tree. For ship (GPU app), the deps are already foundational — -Dhas-window is informational. Carts that don't reference Window pay zero (the file tree-shakes out).

canvas.note: wgpu-native is foundational; this flag only gates Canvas-primitive Zig code. No auto-trigger today — pass -Dhas-canvas manually.

graph.note: wgpu-native is foundational; this flag only gates Graph-primitive Zig code. No auto-trigger today — pass -Dhas-graph manually.

text-rendering.note: freetype is foundational; this flag only gates text-rendering Zig code paths. No auto-trigger today — pass -Dhas-text-rendering manually.

image.note: stb-image is foundational; this flag only gates Image-primitive Zig code. No auto-trigger today — pass -Dhas-image manually.

video.note: wgpu-native is foundational. libmpv is dlopen'd at runtime — the registry entry exists so pack-sdk knows to stage libmpv.so.2 alongside the SDK payload when has-video, not because it gets link-time gated. No auto-trigger today; -Dhas-video is passed manually for video-using carts.

audio.note: Triggered by carts importing runtime/audio.tsx. Compiles framework/audio.zig (SDL3 audio + LuaJIT DSP engine via the zluajit Zig module).

midi.note: Linux MIDI input via ALSA sequencer (framework/midi_real.zig). Carts that don't import useMIDI get framework/midi_stub.zig; libasound is not linked. The dispatcher pattern matches audio.zig / luajit_worker.zig / sqlite.zig / vterm.zig.

deej.note: Serial fader-board input (framework/deej.zig) for homemade deej mixers — Arduino printing '|'-separated 10-bit values over /dev/ttyACM*/ttyUSB*. Plain POSIX serial, no native libs. Carts import useDeej(); no hardware = clean degrade (connected:false, zero events).

physics.note: No auto-trigger today — pass -Dhas-physics manually for carts using the box2d-backed physics primitives.

sqlite.note: __sql_* is its own ingredient (v8_bindings_sqlite.zig, STOREDB-0606); the old has-telemetry piggyback is retired. libsqlite3 is dlopen'd at runtime, so has-sqlite only gates host-fn registration + .so bundling.

sdk.note: Now triggers off the tiered networking stack: useTheInternet (tier 0) plus the tier 1/2 hooks that compose it (fetch, useFetchBrowser, useBrowse). The old http.ts + browser_page.ts triggers were retired when those files were absorbed into useTheInternet (commit 8a844f23a). libcurl has been removed; the backend is std.http.Client + tls.zig. nghttp2 should be added here once its native dep wiring lands.

audio_input.note: Raw mic capture (44.1kHz f32 mono, no VAD) for music sampling. Sibling to voice — same SDL3 input source, different state machine. framework/audio_input/audio_input.zig is always compiled (wired unconditionally into engine.run); this gate only controls __rawCapture_* host-fn registration.

whisper.note: Heavy: compiles deps/whisper.cpp + ggml into libwhisper.so (~20 MB) and statically pulls libstdc++ into the cart binary (~80 MB). Carts that don't import runtime/hooks/whisper.ts pay nothing.

paintable.note: Persistent GPU mask textures (framework/gpu/paintable.zig) + brush ops via __paintable_circle/__paintable_polygon/__paintable_upload/__paintable_readback. Carts that import usePaintable() get an R8Unorm texture per handle to paint into; consumers sample via <Effect textures=...>. Cost is a handful of host fns + a render pipeline at init.

onnx.note: Embeds onnxruntime + registers __onnx_* / __segment_* / __pose_* host fns. MobileSAM segmentation (cart/cutout) + MoveNet pose estimation (the editor's animation capture, req_2786). Carts that import neither trigger pay nothing — onnxruntime.so is ~22MB.

lua-worker.note: Off-thread LuaJIT compute worker (framework/process/luajit_worker.zig). Always compiled; libluajit-5.1 is dlopen'd at runtime so there is no -D flag. Carts that import runtime/hooks/useLuaWorker.ts pull in __lua_* bindings (always-registered, see v8_ingredients.zig) AND get libluajit-5.1.so staged next to the binary by pack-sdk.

physics-lab-host.note: Registers the __physics_lab_* packed host physics used by the standalone physics lab toy ONLY. The game's __hmsc_* sim graduated to framework/game/ behind the game-physics feature (WO-1).

game-physics.note: The game's host-side physics + movement (framework/game/physics.zig + movement.zig, V1/V7/V18), registered by framework/v8_bindings_game_physics.zig. Host fns keep their legacy __hmsc_* names (plus honest __game_physics_* aliases) so cart JS callers keep working. Fires for carts shipping the hmsc host-physics bridge or anything importing the cart/hmsc-int/game/ ground floor. A 2D interface cart pays zero bytes and zero host fns.

game-build.note: The iso world editor's placement brain — raycast/placementFor/validatePlacement/piece queries — ported verbatim from cart/hmsc-int/game/build/*.ts into host-owned framework/game/build.zig (req_2349), registered by framework/v8_bindings_game_build.zig as __game_build_*. Fires when a cart bundles the runtime/game/build.ts door. This is what lets the editor stop cross-importing the whole game cart (req_2178) to place a floor: it calls the host fns instead.

game-map.note: The map painter's authoring engine (framework/game/map/: chunk grid + brush stamps + stroke engine), ported from the cart/hmsc-int 2D tile map painter (req_2473), registered by framework/v8_bindings_game_map.zig as __map_*. Fires when a cart bundles the runtime/game/map.ts door. Painting terrain height, ground tiles, water, flora, and zones runs host-side — React only arms the tool.

game-pathing.note: The game's host-side pathing (framework/game/pathing.zig, V5/V18), registered by framework/v8_bindings_game_pathing.zig: grid A* with per-agent cost profiles + flow penalties, lane discipline (trio-center snap + junction apexes, opt-in via kind classes), and deterministic motion plans. Host fns keep their legacy __path_* names (plus honest __game_pathing_* aliases) so cart JS callers keep working. Fires for carts importing runtime/pathing.ts (legacy face) or the cart/hmsc-int/game/pathing.ts door.

game-camera.note: The game's native host-side camera controller (framework/game/camera.zig, V23), registered by framework/v8_bindings_game_camera.zig: opt-in Scene3D.Camera ownership with Orbit/Aim solves, smoothing, and per-frame node-field writes before the 3D renderer builds matrices. Carts that never call __game_camera_* stay on the existing declarative JS-props camera path.

compiled-world.note: Embedded compiled-world primitive for hmsc-int: React mounts one WorldLoader host node; world_loader.zig constructs and steps the baked game-file runtime, then gpu/3d.zig renders that loader-owned Scene3D tree without per-frame V8 or React reconciliation. WORLDWIN-0611: the same ingredient registers __compiled_world_window/_close/_status — the pop-out OS window (framework/gpu/world_window.zig: a second wgpu surface on the same device, the world rendered to a detached RT and blitted).

pg.note: Postgres client (pg.zig) + auto-spawn of embedded postgres at ~/.cache/reactjit-embed/embed-pg/. Free side effect of useEmbed since embedding storage rides the same socket.

embed.note: Local embedding + retrieval via libllama_ffi.so (linked from tsz/zig-out/lib at build). Chat generation no longer rides this gate — useLocalChat dlopens an LM Studio backend at runtime (framework/local_ai_runtime.zig) and is gated by has-sdk for its host bindings.

doom.note: Vendored doomgeneric (id Software Doom + ozkl porting shim) compiled into the cart. ~30K LOC of C, adds ~600KB to the binary. Carts that don't import useDoom pay nothing.

frame-capture.note: SELFSHOT-0606: __capture_frame(path) — the app screenshots its OWN rendered frame (framework/gpu/capture.zig readback → PNG), registered by framework/v8_bindings_capture.zig. The replacement for the BANNED desktop/X11 capture of the user's system. Carts opt in by importing runtime/capture.ts (the captureFrame door).

imageops.note: @reactjit/image: a Sharp-style decode/resize/encode service (__imageops_*, framework/v8_bindings_image_ops.zig → framework/image/codec.zig). PNG/JPEG via the foundational stb_image + stb_image_write; resize via vendored stb_image_resize2; WebP via libwebp dlopen'd at runtime (no link-time cost — present on most Linux desktops, staged by pack-sdk when bundled). The heavy raw RGBA never crosses the JS↔Zig FFI: carts pass compressed bytes/base64 in and get compressed bytes back. Carts opt in by importing runtime/image.ts.
